pages.text: A little bell hangs on the bakery door. It jingles when the door opens.
Tomorrow morning Coco will open the door for the first time. That jingle will be Coco's too.
Grandpa Mole heard the news. "Then I'll be the first customer. I'll wait outside."
The next morning, it was still dark. Grandpa was already sitting on a chair outside the door.
Coco got up and washed their face. Blue morning light began to brighten the window.
Coco stood at the door with the key. A loud snore came from outside.
Grandpa was asleep in his chair. He had come so early that he had fallen asleep.
The door opened wide. Jingle! The bell rang.
Grandpa woke with a start. "Your first customer is here!" Coco smiled and held out freshly baked bread.
